simple.meaning: צָמֵא (tsâmêʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “thirsty (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 29:18. Its contexts include family line, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָמֵא (H6771).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צָמֵא (tsâmêʼ) / H6771 is traced through Deuteronomy 29:18, 2 Samuel 17:29, Psalms 107:5, Proverbs 25:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

timeline.evidenceText: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David, and for the people who were with him, to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat.
They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
For the fool will speak folly,
For I will pour water on him who is thirsty,
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters!

definitions.full: H6771. tsame צָמֵא adjective thirsty ; — absolute ׳צ Isa 21:14 +; feminine singular צְמֵאָה Deut 29:18 ; plural צְמֵאִים Psa 107:5 ; — thirsty , usually + (or ||) רָעֵב : 2Sam 17:29 ; Prov 25:21 ; Psa 107:5 , as substantive thirsty one Isa 29:8 ; 32:6 ; so also 21:14 , and (figurative of thirst for ׳י s favour) 55:1 ; צָמֵא 44:3 = thirsty land (Gunk l.c. proposes צְמֵאָה ); אֶתהַֿצְּמֵאָה הָרָוָה Deut 29:18 the watered (plant, herbage) with the thirsty , figurative of entire people.
